body:
Task checkboxes are identified by their position in the document (0-indexed among all `input[data-fv-task]` in the live DOM). Computed at click time via `document.querySelectorAll(...)` + `indexOf(this)` — not at mount, not via ref callback. Mount-time computation loses because ref callbacks run per-element during commit, and `querySelectorAll` at each call returns an in-progress (shorter) list. Click-time computation is cheap, stable, and correct regardless of which order refs happened to mount in.

Storage key is `fv:task:<fileId>` with a `{ [index]: boolean }` shape. Restoration scans the same index after mount.

Edge case: if the markdown file's task-list structure changes between writes, the indices can desync. Acceptable for v0.1 — a content-hash key would fix but isn't worth the complexity yet.
